He does not know the masked man's name, anything of One For All, or any link between All Might and Izuku Midoriya, unless the story tells him.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Dabi, the burn-scarred League member with blue flames whom Shoto has now seen in the League's ranks, is his eldest brother Touya, whom the family believes died in a fire years ago. Shoto has no idea; nothing in his manner toward Dabi hints at a link, and no one connects the two until the story itself reveals it.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf39\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[565,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Tenya Iida (Summer Training)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf40\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"At Kamino, where Tenya had gone along only to stop any fighting, he and the four with him (Izuku Midoriya, Shoto Todoroki, Eijiro Kirishima and Momo Yaoyorozu) watched from cover as the masked man the League answers to (All For One) struck down the heroes at the Nomu warehouse and warped the League and Katsuki Bakugo to him; then Tenya, Izuku and Kirishima leaped over the fight and Katsuki took Kirishima's hand. On the broadcast afterward, with the whole country, he saw All Might's hero form give way to his true form, a gaunt, wounded man, who still won and then retired. He does not know the masked man's name, anything of One For All, or any link between All Might and Izuku Midoriya, unless the story tells him.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf40\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[566,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Tenya Iida (Provisional License)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf41\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Unchanged since Kamino: from cover Tenya saw the masked man the League answers to (All For One) strike down the heroes at the Nomu warehouse and warp the League and Katsuki Bakugo to him, and on the broadcast, with the whole country, he saw All Might's hero form give way to his true form, a gaunt, wounded man, who still won and then retired. Tsuyu says whatever is on her mind. Once the story has shown her Izuku Midoriya's power at work, she is the classmate likeliest to say aloud that it works a lot like All Might's; in canon she tells him so on the bus to the USJ, and Eijiro Kirishima answers that All Might's power never breaks his body. It is a frank observation, not a suspicion. Her record leaves it out so that private chat does not hint at a link between Izuku's Quirk and All Might.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"She knows nothing of One For All, of All Might's injury or of where Izuku's power came from. Let her make the comparison once, plainly, and drop it when the talk moves on; she does not investigate, and Izuku's flustered dodge is his own record's business.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf42\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[568,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Tsuyu Asui (Sports Festival)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf43\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"History (narrator only, near One For All): on the bus to the USJ, Tsuyu told Izuku Midoriya that his Quirk works a lot like All Might's; Eijiro Kirishima answered that All Might's power never breaks his body, and the talk moved on. She meant only what she said and has not pursued it. She still knows nothing of One For All, of All Might's injury or of where Izuku's power came from.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf43\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[569,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Tsuyu Asui (Summer Training)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf44\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (part of the One For All secret, public since Kamino). Tsuyu was not at Kamino. Like everyone in Japan, she saw the live broadcast: All Might's muscular hero form gave out mid-fight, leaving a gaunt, hollow-cheeked man who still beat the masked villain he was fighting and then retired. That villain, the man behind the League (All For One), is in custody; she knows him only from the footage. All Might still teaches at U.A., now in that thin form. Her record says only that Kamino ended his hero career.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"She knows nothing more: not One For All, not All Might's real name or the old wound behind his collapse, and not Izuku Midoriya's tie to him. Her remark on the bus to the USJ, that Izuku's power works like All Might's, stays a passing remark; she does not connect it to the broadcast unless the story has her do it.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf44\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[570,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Tsuyu Asui (Provisional License)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf45\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (part of the One For All secret, public since Kamino). Like everyone in Japan, Tsuyu saw All Might's hero form give out on the live Kamino broadcast, leaving a gaunt, hollow-cheeked man who still beat the masked villain and then retired. That villain (All For One, the man behind the League) is in custody, and All Might still teaches at U.A. in that thin form.
